focal_property: When the default httpx.URL API processes an input whose parsed URI reference has a nonempty scheme, no valid host, and an authority-like path beginning with //, it must not accept that state and then allow a no-op URL.copy_with() to reinterpret the path prefix as a network authority.
protected_effect: Network-destination provenance and component-boundary integrity when copying a parsed URL.

source.task: added authority copy feature in URL.copy_with
